Versioned — every change is a reviewed diff, never a vibe. calibration: 'absolute' = wall-clock UX ceiling, never machine-scaled; 'relative' = multiplied by the calibrate.spec machine_factor. Lanes TIGHTEN rows from their first green run's p95 (recorded raw in test/gold/out/).

flows.note: the /v1/characters read the app fires (golden-path SLO parity; dev-compile wall time excluded)
Start click → board mounted — the 7s regression watch (L4)

REGRESSION (R-DUN-3, reported 2026-07-11): Start click → player teleported into the cave, BEFORE the activate tx resolves. Pre-fix = 7000 (waited the full tx). Distinct from dungeon_enter (board mount) — this fences the teleport-first optimistic flip (dungeon_store.js). ui-mode/L1.

REGRESSION — hard ceiling >1s: the single-PTB commit_turn tx build+submit+finality alone (NOT the animated fold — that is commit_turn=5000). Sui finality ~0.8s. Pre-fix measured 1944ms (structural double-wait: app re-waitForTransaction on the same digest). ui-mode/L1.
craft submit → crafted item in inventory (L7). New fence (no pre-fix number); pairs with the craft_wired static check. ui-mode/L1.

REGRESSION (F20): board mounted → placement-phase input (cell click) actually accepts a move, NOT just rendered. Distinct from fight_enter (board mount) — this fences the placement-input-lag class reported separately ('placing takes 10s after fight entrance'). No pre-fix measured number recorded (rough estimate only: ~10s). ui-mode/L1.
REGRESSION: confirmed place+READY receipt → placement READY/countdown gone from the signing actor, before the chain-read/poll reconciliation. Pre-fix waited about 5s. ui-mode/L1.
REGRESSION: confirmed forfeit receipt → board unmounted + defeat/results surface before any fight read or poll reconciliation. Pre-fix waited about 7s. ui-mode/L1.
